signals.summary: A wave of late-August recipe roundups centered on peak-season tomatoes, corn, stone fruit and cucumbers — gazpacho, tomato salads, corn pasta, fruit desserts. The seasonal push to use up end-of-summer produce before fall.
signals.why_now: Roughly ten independent seasonal-recipe items cluster here, freshest a green-tomato gazpacho at ~45h and an August cucumber-tomato salad at ~198h, alongside multiple Food & Wine and BuzzFeed August/summer-produce roundups. Seasonal peak is right now (late Aug), so older items remain postable under the seasonal exemption.

signals.summary: The high-protein craze keeps spreading across formats — protein ice cream, protein-fortified dairy and snacks, pork rinds, and high-protein takes on fast-food handhelds. Protein as the dominant reformulation angle of 2026.
signals.why_now: Seven-plus independent items across trade and consumer outlets carry it — a Forbes 'protein ice cream is summer's next trend' piece, an Aussie high-protein brand story at ~81h, multiple Baking Business items (protein/fiber, pork rinds, dairy protein), a savoury-protein trends report, and a viral high-protein crunchwrap video. Evergreen momentum rather than a spike.

signals.summary: A broad resurgence of home and small-batch baking — micro-bakeries, biscuit pop-ups, backyard baking, honor-system bakery stands, salt bread and rice-flour bakes — plus a surge in baking cookbooks. Baked goods as the comfort-craft aesthetic of the moment.
signals.why_now: Many independent baking-trend items converge on the same theme: a Backyard Baking culinary-trend piece at ~175h, biscuits expanding via pop-ups/chains, an 80% surge in baking cookbook sales, honor-system bakeries, and viral micro-bakery formats. Diverse sources, evergreen craft momentum.

signals.summary: Home cooks and brands leaning into international flavor profiles — Japanese ingredients, evolved Mexican, Indian chatpata/spice, and globally-inspired supermarket products. World cuisines as the flavor direction of 2026.
signals.why_now: Five independent items across regions and outlets: a Japanese-cuisine ingredient debut (Trend Hunter, ~79h), an evolving Mexican-food-trend piece, a survey on Brits embracing adventurous global flavours, an Indian chatpata-flavours trends report, and a globally-inspired Chobani creamer launch. Cross-source and ongoing.
